name: Calendar
description: Reads and edits the Mac's calendars (every macOS system account: iCloud, Google, Exchange) and serves them to the calendar views and the Personal AI

source_enabled.label: Show Mac calendars
source_enabled.help: Off keeps the plugin loaded but serves no events. Settings → Calendar writes this.

hidden_calendar_ids.label: Hidden calendars
hidden_calendar_ids.help: Calendar ids to leave out of every view.

visible_calendar_ids.label: Visible calendars
visible_calendar_ids.help: When set, ONLY these calendar ids show, including calendars added to the Mac later.

refresh_minutes.label: Background poll (minutes)
refresh_minutes.help: How often cached windows are re-read so open views hear about changes nobody asked for.

read_ttl_seconds.label: Read staleness (seconds)
read_ttl_seconds.help: How stale a served read may be before it re-reads the Mac. 0 never serves from cache.
